# Security policy

## Supported versions

Only the `main` branch of this repository receives fixes. The Zenodo archive
([10.5281/zenodo.21873314](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21873314)) is the
fixed version used in the paper and is not updated.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please do not report security problems through public issues. Use the
**Report a vulnerability** button in the Security tab of this repository, or
write to <pierrebdef@gmail.com>.

Reports will be acknowledged and fixed on `main` as soon as possible. Errors
in the analyses or the data are not security problems; report them through
issues (see [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md)).
